npcs.name: Lilly
npcs.greeting: Hello! I could use a little help with something from the slime fields.

npcs.name: Jorge
npcs.greeting: Good to see you. The roads are safer when everyone lends a hand.

npcs.name: Mara
npcs.greeting: The shop is still being stocked, but you're welcome in town.

npcs.name: Eldon
npcs.greeting: Oakrest is quiet today. I hope it stays that way.

npcs.name: Rhea
npcs.greeting: There's always something happening beyond the town road.

npcs.name: Torren
npcs.greeting: Come back when the forge is open and I'll show you what I can make.

npcs.name: Farmer
npcs.greeting: Mind the animals and watch your step around the trough.

quests.title: Lilly's Slime Samples
quests.description: Bring Lilly three samples of Slime Gel from the nearby slime fields.
quests.openingDialogue: I'm trying to learn more about the slimes outside town. Could you bring me twenty samples of Slime Gel?
quests.completionDialogue: Perfect! These samples are exactly what I needed. Thank you!

quests.title: Jorge's Slime Problem
quests.description: Thin out the slimes near Oakrest so the road stays safe.
quests.openingDialogue: Lilly says you've been helping around town. The slimes are getting too comfortable near the road. Defeat 20 of them for me.
quests.completionDialogue: Nicely done. That should keep the road clear for a while.

quests.title: Wolf Hunt
quests.description: These darn wolves keep attacking my animal. Think you could go out and give them a taste of their own medicine?
quests.openingDialogue: Could you help me and my animals?
quests.completionDialogue: Thank you! Hopefully now these mangy muts will leave my animals alone!

quests.title: Welcome Traveler
quests.description: Introduce yourself to the people of Little Realm
quests.openingDialogue: Welcome to Little Realm! We are pleased to have you. Please get to know the other folks around town, I'm sure they will be delighted to meet you!
quests.completionDialogue: I'm glad you made some new friends! Enjoy your stay!
